chars.counting_rule: UTF-8 decoded characters in authored runtime index.html, story.css and story.js; excludes shared chassis, D3, raw CSV, images, tests, reports and screenshots

changes: Removed repeated SVG enter attributes that the common update path immediately assigned with the same values.
Delegated the dynamically rendered domain-copy controls to one readable listener set instead of registering fresh closures on every render.
Centralized owned native listeners and teardown, adding touchcancel cleanup while preserving the public controller and D3 listener lifecycle.
Reused the chassis clamp and removed CSS declarations already inherited or exactly duplicated by the settled base state.
Kept the XMLHttpRequest loader because its status-zero branch is required for the sample's supported local file execution path.

tests.name: fixed-state pixel and DOM equivalence
tests.evidence: State/controller snapshots, cards, bars, stacks, domain opacity and all paired screenshots were equal.

tests.name: canonical data and chart encoding
tests.evidence: The runtime parser retained 4,801 records, 45 annual rows, a 287 maximum, 27.054108px band width, y=800 baseline and exact yearly stack totals.

tests.name: navigation, queued motion and direct manipulation
tests.evidence: Forward/reverse keyboard, bidirectional wheel, touch swipe, a queued rapid double advance, legend controls and delegated copy controls reached the same canonical states.

tests.name: motion and reduced motion
tests.evidence: Outgoing/incoming card directions, image clipping and exact 80ms progressive bar delays were preserved; reduced motion settles immediately with all reveal delays zero.

tests.name: reset, cancellation and lifecycle
tests.evidence: Independent resets were deterministic; touchcancel did not navigate; destroy and pagehide cancelled pending motion and removed input listeners; reload rebuilt one canonical ready instance.

tests.name: resource failure
tests.evidence: A forced CSV failure exposed the same textual fallback and produced baseline/candidate RGB AE=0.

tests.name: local-file selfcheck
tests.evidence: The candidate loaded its CSV under file:// with no clipping, escape, overlap, undersized text, failed resources or runtime errors.

tests.name: normal runtime
tests.evidence: The canonical interaction suite completed with zero page errors, console errors, failed requests or external requests.

cross_audit.scope: Independent chart-reference audit of formal immutability, author metrics, CSV aggregation/domain encoding, fixed states, inputs, reduced motion, double reset, resize, fallback, pagehide disposal and reload.

rejected_changes.change: replace the local loader with a shorter fetch-only implementation
rejected_changes.reason: fetch cannot load the local file URL used by the sample's selfcheck, so this would be a real compatibility regression

rejected_changes.change: compress story states, category records or transitions into opaque positional tuples
rejected_changes.reason: would reduce the sample's value as a readable chart-story reference

rejected_changes.change: drop annual records, domain stacks, hover states, images or narrative motion
rejected_changes.reason: would lower evidence, interaction or visual quality rather than improve code
